entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Akshay Chandra, A
 Mr. P.N. Upadhyay, Ad
 versus
 State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr.

Through: Mr. Satinder Singh Ba  the State with SI Kam  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI  ORDER % 20.03.2023

By way of the present petition under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 592/2020 dated 14.12.2020 registered under sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Hauz Khas premised on a settlement deed and a divorce decree.

2. However, Mr. Akshay Chandra, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that having signed the settlement deed and having obtained divorce, respondent No. 2 has expressed certain reservations in relation to the phraseology in the petition.

3. In the circumstances, before proceeding further with the matter, let a copy of this order be communicated by the petitioner to respondent No. 2 with a request to remain present in court on the next date.

4. Let a copy of this order be also communicated to respondent No. 2 through the Investigating Officer and the counsel representing respondent No.2 in other matters.
5. Petitioner No. 1, who is stated to be ordinarily residing in the U.K., is permitted to join via video-conferencing.
6.
The other petitioners are requested to remain present in court on the next date.

7. Re-notify on 13th April 2023.
